description: Static compatibility rules evaluated by the compat-scan command. Each rule declares documented Android platform behaviour. Rules flag risk; they do not prove runtime failure. Extend this file rather than editing code.

compat_rules.title: Component with an intent-filter lacks android:exported
compat_rules.detail: {count} component(s) declare an intent-filter but no explicit android:exported. On Android 12+ (API 31) with this targetSdk the package fails to install with INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_MANIFEST_MALFORMED.
compat_rules.remediation: Set android:exported="true" only for entry points that must be reachable; otherwise set "false" and expose the behaviour through a permission-guarded component.

compat_rules.title: targetSdk below the current store requirement
compat_rules.detail: targetSdk is {target}; Google Play has required API 35 for new submissions and updates. Sideloaded and preserved builds are unaffected by the store rule, but platform behaviour changes for the declared level still apply.
compat_rules.remediation: Raise targetSdk and re-test the behaviour changes listed for each intermediate API level.

compat_rules.title: Application permits cleartext HTTP traffic
compat_rules.detail: android:usesCleartextTraffic is true, so plaintext HTTP is allowed everywhere. On API 28+ the platform default is false; enabling it widens attack surface and may be rejected by store review.
compat_rules.remediation: Remove the flag and scope any legacy endpoint through a network security config with an explicit domain allow-list.

compat_rules.title: Release artifact is debuggable
compat_rules.detail: android:debuggable is true. Any adb-authorized host can attach a debugger, read process memory and use run-as against the app's private data.
compat_rules.remediation: Build a release variant with debuggable false before distributing; keep debug builds inside your own test fleet.

compat_rules.title: Application allows backup of private data
compat_rules.detail: android:allowBackup is true without dataExtractionRules. On API 31+ the platform limits cloud backup, but device-to-device transfer still applies.
compat_rules.remediation: Set allowBackup="false" or declare explicit backup/dataExtractionRules XML if user data must move with the app.

compat_rules.title: Package ships only 32-bit native code
compat_rules.detail: No 64-bit native library is packaged. 64-bit-only devices cannot load 32-bit-only apps where the 32-bit loader is absent.
compat_rules.remediation: Produce a genuine arm64-v8a build from source. A closed-source 32-bit library cannot be converted into a valid 64-bit implementation by re-packaging.

compat_rules.title: extractNativeLibs=true forces install-time extraction
compat_rules.detail: Native libraries are unpacked to the data partition at install time, which increases install size and defeats the mmap-from-APK optimisation used when libraries are stored uncompressed and page aligned.
compat_rules.remediation: Set android:extractNativeLibs="false", keep .so entries stored, and align them with zipalign -P 16 -f 4.

compat_rules.title: requestLegacyExternalStorage is set
compat_rules.detail: The legacy storage model is requested. It is ignored when targetSdk is 30 or higher, so the flag no longer changes behaviour on current devices.
compat_rules.remediation: Migrate file access to scoped storage APIs; keep the flag only if an Android 10 lane still needs it.

compat_rules.title: minSdk declares pre-ART (API < 21) support
compat_rules.detail: minSdk is below 21. Dalvik-era packaging rules, multidex limits and TLS defaults differ substantially, and modern libraries frequently require API 21+.
compat_rules.remediation: Confirm the pre-21 lane is genuinely required and tested; otherwise raise minSdk to a level you can verify.

compat_rules.title: No network security config declared
compat_rules.detail: The app relies on platform defaults for trust anchors and cleartext policy. That is acceptable for pure HTTPS apps, but there is no per-domain control when a legacy endpoint still needs an exception.
compat_rules.remediation: Add android:networkSecurityConfig only when a specific domain must be scoped; it is not required for standard HTTPS.
